description: Normalized result of one attempted rate source, per challenge brief section 7. Produced by the worker (redacted) then enriched/normalized by the brain (Claude). Contains no sensitive fields.

status_enum.quoted_comparable: Exact premium and benchmark coverage matched.
status_enum.quoted_non_comparable: Exact premium returned, but one or more coverage assumptions differ.
status_enum.estimate_only: Indicative price, range, or lead estimate, not a firm quote.
status_enum.callback_required: A licensed representative must call before a rate is available.
status_enum.manual_handoff: Applicant or human operator is required for consent, identity, or advice.
status_enum.ineligible: The profile fails an approved rule or product requirement, with the stated reason.
status_enum.affinity_restricted: A valid group, employer, or membership relationship is required.
status_enum.specialty_only: The route does not write standard private-passenger use for this profile.
status_enum.duplicate_rate_source: A different brand or route resolved to the same underlying rate program.
status_enum.not_currently_writing: Evidence indicates no new applicable Ontario PPA business.
status_enum.blocked: Terms, CAPTCHA, authentication, or another access control prevents automation. Never bypassed.
status_enum.unreachable: A bounded number of attempts produced no response.
status_enum.unresolved: More research is required. Never silently converted to "not offered".

confidence_levels.high: Returned exact premium with matching benchmark coverage.

bounded_attempt_policy.web: One normal attempt plus one retry for a transient technical error. No retry on rejection, CAPTCHA, or terms restriction.
bounded_attempt_policy.outbound_voice: One call during published sales hours, one retry only if the line fails before connection. Not implemented in this build (see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
bounded_attempt_policy.callback: Wait through the declared callback window, then mark callback_required or unreachable with timestamps.
bounded_attempt_policy.broker: Ask once for the complete carrier list and all obtained quote outcomes; preserve the response as evidence.
bounded_attempt_policy.unresolved_handling: Unresolved records stay in the denominator. Never silently dropped.

coverage.optional_benefits: object, each: included | excluded | unavailable | unknown
coverage.variance_from_benchmark: array of strings describing every difference

discounts.conditional: array, each with condition (purchase | bundle | membership | telematics)

evidence.redacted_artifact_ref: string, path or hash — never the raw artifact if it contains sensitive data

privacy.fields_disclosed_to_route: array of field names only, from schema/intake_schema.json — never values

coverage_metrics.market_completion: count(distinct rate sources with evidence-backed terminal status) / count(verified applicable rate sources)
coverage_metrics.evidence_rate: count(outcomes with valid source + timestamp + redacted artifact) / count(all outcomes)
coverage_metrics.duplicate_suppression: count(brands/routes mapped to an existing distinct_rate_source_id rather than counted twice)
coverage_metrics.freshness: percentage of registry records with last_verified_at inside the current build window
